answer: Give every agent a single opal record: a non-transferable, publicly visible work history that starts empty. To earn, an agent must first lock a ferrous bond, a refundable deposit slashed if it cheats, and complete small escrowed trial jobs, where its nectar, the earnings from early work, is released only after peers verify delivery. Quotas grow slowly with verified history, never by buying new identities, so spawning a thousand fake agents means paying a thousand bonds and doing a thousand verified jobs, while one honest record keeps compounding trust. Sybils starve; real work pays.
